parts.name: ESP32-CAM (AI-Thinker, OV2640)
parts.notes: Aideepen 2-pack ESP32-CAM + ESP32-CAM-MB (CH340G, micro-USB), AI-Thinker pinout, 4 MB PSRAM. Board 27 x 40.5 x 4.5 mm (DFRobot DFR0602 datasheet). Roughly $18 per 2-pack (price not shown in search, check page); cost here is per board+MB set. Search: ESP32-CAM-MB OV2640 2 pack

parts.name: ESP32-CAM-MB
parts.notes: Included with the ESP32-CAM line above (same pack). ~40 x 27 mm, micro-USB on the short edge (retailer listings, no official drawing).

parts.name: 5V 2A USB wall adapter
parts.notes: MaxRenard 5 V 2 A UL-certified USB-A charger (model DF10A-050200-US), 2-pack ~$10. Search: 5V 2A USB wall charger UL listed

parts.name: Micro-USB cable (1.8 m)
parts.notes: USB-A to micro-USB data cable, 6 ft, slim plug (overmould <= 12 x 8 mm to pass the bottom cap). Search: micro USB cable 6ft 3 pack

parts.name: 220 ohm resistor
parts.notes: 1/4 W, in line on the LED anode, covered with heat-shrink. Search: 220 ohm resistor 1/4W 100 pcs

parts.name: Heat-shrink tubing + 26 AWG wire
parts.notes: Two 10 cm leads from the LED to the MB header joints. Use a green 5 mm LED for the status light. Search: heat shrink tubing kit

parts.name: M3×16 self-tapping screw for plastic
parts.notes: search: M3 x 16mm pan head self tapping screws for plastic

soldering_reason: The status LED's leads (with an in-line 220 ohm resistor) solder to the IO13 and GND header joints on the back of the ESP32-CAM-MB, because the MB covers the camera board's pins.
